short_summary: Vista Do Sol Centre: no distinct official website found -- only aggregator/directory listings (Tiendeo, Cylex) and one tenant (Steers) turned up via search, none confirming a dedicated centre site. Likely a small/single-anchor centre. Skipped, no changes.

Eco Park: discovered Eco Boulevard shopping centre (own site ecoboulevard.co.za) and added 3 verified tenants -- Beyond Bowling, Checkers Eco Boulevard, Virgin Active Eco Park -- each with a phone and address from two agreeing directory sources. Discarded Wing Wah Sushi, Mehak Indian Restaurant and So-cie-tea: found in the mall but couldn't pin an explicitly-stated phone number to them.

Eersterust: added Eersterust Plaza shopping centre (Cnr Hans Coverdale & West St) and 2 standalone businesses -- Stadium Pharmacy and BP Eersterust Motors. Discarded The Den (no address found), Civimed Pharmacy (conflicting addresses across sources for the same phone number), Eersterust Pharmacy and PEP Eersterust (only single-sourced or suburb attribution unclear vs. neighbouring Silverton/Mamelodi).

Elardus Park: added Elardus Park Shopping Centre (also referred to as The Park Shopping Centre in some listings -- same site at Cnr Delmas Rd & Barnard St, confirmed by tenant addresses matching both names) and 3 verified tenants -- Dis-Chem Pharmacy Elarduspark, Elarduspark Pet Shop And Dog Parlor, The Daily Coffee Café Elardus Park. Existing standalone businesses at this centre (Cash Crusaders, PostNet Elarduspark, etc.) were left untouched, as linking existing rows is job 3's job, not this suburb sweep's.

Interactive one-off batch (per owner request) of 15 descriptions, alphabetically from the backlog start (Beyond Bowling through Elarduspark Pet Shop And Dog Parlor). One search + one fetch per business, per the new bounded-research rule. Fell back to reworded for 6 where the single research pass found nothing citable (dead/inactive sites for Eclat Technologies and eDream Productions, blank page for eco-one, no matching result for e-BIZWHIZZ, ambiguous non-specific match for derdepoort and eL and Tee Events Management).
